stem: Which quotation from President Harry S. Truman offers a reason for U.S. involvement in the conflict between North Korea and South Korea?

options.label: F
options.text: "The United Nations cannot . . . fulfill adequately its own responsibilities until the peace settlements have been made. . . ."

options.label: G
options.text: "Above all else, we want to keep the United States prosperous and strong because we know that our prosperity is the best guarantee of peace."

options.label: H
options.text: "Communism has passed beyond the use of subversion . . . and will now use armed invasion and war."

options.label: J
options.text: "As a result of these tragic conditions, a millitant minority, exploiting human want and misery . . . has made economic recovery impossible."
